description: Roll 1 to 100 dice with 2 to 1000 sides each (default one six-sided die). The answer is a drawstoday.com link where the result is shown; the answer itself carries no result.

seed.description: Optional. 64 hex characters. Give the seed shown on an earlier result page to get the same result again (that is how a draw is checked). Leave it out for a fresh draw.

name: roll_dice
title: Roll dice
